items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: so I left Speed's band to join Milt Senior in Toledo

ctx.x: Well, Art got a job with WSPD Radio, and this is still about 1930 now, I guess, we're getting to -- and Art had played a half-hour solo every day of the week at five o'clock in the afternoon, and he did that and did it rather than play in little teeny small bands.

So Milt contacted me with the Speed Webb Band, and so I left Speed's band to join Milt Senior in Toledo, because it was steady, no road, and just like month in and month out, one job in one place, and location was right, and it was right for me.
